observation.depicts: Two dark translucent mod menu panels side by side over a blurred dark forest: Spawn Menu with Options on the left, Main Menu with Player options on the right.
observation.text_readable: "Spawn Menu", "Options", "Despawn All", "Go to Closest", "Main Menu", "Player", "Give All Items", "God Mode". Slider values "Fly Mode: 100", "Speed: 13", "Jump: 8" are readable.
observation.composition: Two panels fill the frame nearly edge to edge with small margins; right Player panel has a cyan outline. Bottom-left has a little empty background.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Very dark background with cyan and white text and dim button outlines; text contrasts well, but button boxes and sliders are low contrast against the dark backdrop.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Text is crisp; background is heavily blurred. Slight colour fringing at some left edges. Cropped from a larger frame, no window chrome. Panel borders show faint banding in dark gradients.
observation.scan_first_read: Two dark menu panels with cyan headings; a game mod interface.

legend.0: Far too few pixels or very soft: detail is mushy or blocky even at the file's native size
legend.1: Small or soft: visible softness or coarse pixels at native size; would look weak enlarged or on high-density screens
legend.2: Adequate: acceptable at native size but with little headroom for enlargement
legend.3: Good: sharp at native size with reasonable headroom
legend.4: Excellent: crisp with ample pixels; holds up when enlarged

legend.1: Only a few large words are readable; most meaningful text is illegible
legend.2: The main text is readable but secondary text is hard to read
legend.3: All meaningful text is readable with slight effort
legend.4: All text is crisp and effortless to read

legend.2: The subject is identifiable with some effort
